boundaries.inactive_zero_correction: retained in the raw atlas as identity evidence but excluded from signal, variance-dominance and mechanism votes
boundaries.state_local_sign_failure: any negative next-independent-batch correction cosine is retained even when the probe-wide mean remains positive
boundaries.state_local_scale_failure: any correctly directed correction larger than the native update is retained even when the probe-wide mean ratio remains below one
boundaries.both_state_harm: routes to a current-state rate or curvature mathematical reformulation; fixed exit, handoff and annealing are forbidden
boundaries.shared_signal: every observed probe must individually pass 0.65 accuracy; a mean pass cannot hide one failed probe
boundaries.method_specific_signal: a signal that fails sharing may remain eligible only for the probes that independently pass
